name: trustlink-pay
description: TrustLink Pay - Identity-first blockchain payments on Solana. Send stablecoins to phone numbers, resolved through TSN privacy-preserving settlement network. Built with WhatsApp auth, Cranker liquidity, and on-chain TINS identity.

author.name: Agbaka Matthew Daniel aka Big Dreams Web3

scripts.// === Core Development ===: Start here. Daily local commands for the main app and TSN stack.
scripts.help: echo "Common commands:" && echo "npm run dev:full              - backend + frontend" && echo "npm run dev:all               - backend + frontend + mempool" && echo "npm run mempool:dev           - TSN mempool API + explorer" && echo "npm run rpc:gateway:dev       - start the TSN RPC gateway" && echo "npm run rpc:gateway:inspect   - inspect gateway upstream order" && echo "npm run tsn:cranker:start     - start real settlement operator" && echo "npm run rpc:inspect           - show active RPC order" && echo "npm run deploy:doctor         - check deploy toolchain"
scripts.dev:full: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend,mempool -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run mempool:dev"
scripts.// === Frontend ===: TrustLink Pay user interface on port 3001.
scripts.// === Backend ===: TrustLink Pay API, user records, notifications, and payment history on port 3000.
scripts.// === Mempool Stack ===: TSN work queue, epoch coordinator, and mempool explorer.
scripts.mempool:backend:dev: cd tsn-protocol/tsn-mempool-backend && set MEMPOOL_STORE=file&& set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1&& python -u server.py
scripts.// === TSN Program ===: Transfer Settlement Network on-chain program and private settlement setup.
scripts.tsn:program:deploy:checked: npm run deploy:lockfiles:stabilize && npm run deploy:doctor && npm run tsn:program:build && npm run tsn:program:deploy
scripts.// === TSN Treasury & Verifier ===: Protocol PDAs used for account creation, sponsorship support, and treasury routing.
scripts.// === TINS Program ===: Transfer Identity Number registry program and identity helpers.
scripts.tins:deploy:checked: npm run deploy:lockfiles:stabilize && npm run deploy:doctor && npm run tins:build && npm run tins:deploy
scripts.// === Cranker Daemon ===: Reference TSN settlement operator. Start after backend, mempool, and programs are ready.
scripts.// === SDKs ===: Build and refresh local SDKs after protocol or generated-code changes.
scripts.sdk:build:all: npm run tsn:sdk:build && npm run tins:sdk:build && npm run tsn:cranker-sdk:build
scripts.sdk:install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix tsn-protocol/tsn-cranker-sdk install && npm --prefix tsn-protocol/tsn-cranker-op-daemon install && npm --prefix tsn-protocol/tsn-mempool-frontend install
scripts.sdk:refresh: npm --prefix tsn-protocol/tsn-sdk install && npm run tsn:sdk:build && npm --prefix tsn-protocol/tsn-cranker-sdk install && npm run tsn:cranker-sdk:build && npm run sdk:install:all && npm run frontend:clean
scripts.// === Utilities & Maintenance ===: IDs, status sync, type checks, and full rebuild/deploy orchestration.
scripts.check:types: npm run tsn:sdk:build && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run frontend:typecheck && cd tsn-protocol/tsn-cranker-op-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck scripts/cranker.ts
scripts.tsn:rebuild:all: npm run tsn:program:build && npm run sdk:refresh
scripts.// === Compatibility Aliases ===: Older names kept so existing notes and terminals do not break.
scripts.tsn:sdk:relink: npm run frontend:install && npm run backend:install
scripts.// === Git & Deployment ===: Repository helpers. Review git status before committing or pushing.
scripts.git:pull:all: git pull origin main && git submodule update --init --recursive
scripts.git:commit:push:all: git add -A && git commit -m "Something just got updated! " && git push --recurse-submodules=on-demand origin main
